customersReady.scope: Customer profiles are shared across this pharmacy organization. Customer selection is optional.
customersReady.search: Search customers by name, phone or email
customersReady.empty: No matching customers. Try another search or create a profile.
customersReady.archiveConfirm: Change this customer’s status? History will be preserved. Save the profile to apply the change.
customersReady.duplicates: A customer already uses this phone or email.
customersReady.sharedContact: A shared phone or email cannot be reused by active profiles under the existing rules. Select the existing person only if it is the same customer, or correct/omit the shared contact.
customersReady.notesHint: Operational notes only. Do not enter medical information.
customersReady.historyPreserved: Editing or archiving this profile preserves original sales and refunds.
customersReady.historyScope: Shows sales from branches your account can access. The latest purchase appears first. Open a sale for payments and refunds.
customersReady.historyPermission: Sales permission is required to view purchase history.
customersReady.manageRequired: Customer creation and editing require customer management permission. You may select an existing customer or continue anonymously.
customersReady.onlineOnly: Connect and refresh pharmacy access before saving customer changes.
customersReady.loadFailed: Customers could not be refreshed. Retry the search.
customersReady.cachedPage: Showing the last synchronized page only; it may be incomplete or stale. Customer changes require a connection.
customersReady.noCachedPage: This search/page is not saved on this device. Connect to search.
customersReady.recovery: The save result is uncertain. Keep these details and check/retry the same customer before starting another profile.
customersReady.saveFailed: Customer could not be saved. Review the details and retry.
customersReady.consent: Recorded consent — marketing: {{marketing}}; service notifications: {{service}}. Delivery depends on configured channels.

errors.CUSTOMER_PHONE: Enter a phone number with 5–20 digits and optional +, spaces, parentheses, dots or hyphens.
errors.CUSTOMER_EMAIL: Enter a valid email address (up to 254 characters).
errors.CUSTOMER_NOTES: Use operational notes of at most 2,000 characters.
errors.CUSTOMER_CONFLICT: This profile changed elsewhere. Close and search again before making a new edit.
errors.CUSTOMER_DUPLICATE: An active customer already uses this phone or email. Select the existing customer or correct the contact.
